caption: The drawing depicts a single large jug made of brownish-beige ceramic material with a slightly speckled surface. The jug has a rounded body that tapers upward into a short, cylindrical neck with a thick, rounded lip. There is a small, curved handle attached near the top on one side. The jug features a decorative design on its front, consisting of a stylized blue floral motif with a large blossom, curving stem, and several elongated leaves, each filled with dark blue dots and lines. Near the top, there is blue text reading "J & J P TRIPP" and "BETWEEN 30 & 32 MARKET ST. ALBANY." The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or lightly yellowed color, with no additional objects or designs. The jug appears upright and centered within the composition.
title: Jug
